items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I recall it because I have a picture that was taken at that time. But I don't really know much about it as of this moment.

ctx.x: I don't remember. I know I didn't think of it as a breakthrough at the time.

One little item on the academic side, around this time -- DownBeat carried an item in March, 1942, that Robert Goffin, the Belgian jazz writer, and Leonard Feather had a chorus called "Jazz Music of America" -- this was in New York, probably in February at the time maybe you were still with, or just finishing up at the Famous Door, and they had a number of guests of honor at the first meeting, among whom, they say were Benny Goodman, Louis Armstrong and Bennie Carter. Any recollection of that?
I recall it because I have a picture that was taken at that time. But I don't really know much about it as of this moment.
